newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan sells third June fuel oil cargo at $100/T.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan sells third June fuel oil cargo at $100/T.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has sold a third 30,000-tonne cargo of 3.0-percent sulphur fuel oil at around $100 per tonne for June lifting, a company source said on Wednesday.
The 180-cst cargo will be lifted June 9-18 on a free-on-board (fob) Kaohsiung basis, the source said.
CPC initially planned to sell 1-2 cargoes. "The price is not very good, so we only awarded one cargo," the source said.
In its last sell tender, CPC sold two 30,000-tonne cargoes at around $101 per tonne, with the first to be lifted in the first half of June and the other in the second half.
The cargoes were awarded on a fob basis.
